purpose: Teach: 移す/解き/外す/謙虚/造り/削っ/抱き/なさら

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、本気で、絶対、本部、絶対、移す、絶対、計画です、本気で、感謝
lines.en: We're committed to moving this to headquarters. I appreciate your trust.
lines.style: Measured and official. Steady opening, slightly formal register. Calm breath. Conviction without warmth. Professional closure.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。警察、本気で、絶対、難事件、絶対、解き、絶対、明かしてありがたいです、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. I'm grateful you're taking this serious case on. Thank you.
lines.style: Respectful agreement. Quick nodding pace. Sincere but not effusive. The tone of someone cooperating fully, not overstepping.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、本気で、絶対、容疑者、絶対、外す、絶対、判断、絶対、致しました、本気で、感謝
lines.en: We've made the decision to look beyond the initial suspect. That's important here.
lines.style: Factual, measured. Light emphasis on the decision-point. No apology in the voice — this is what they do. Calm closure.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。警察、本気で、絶対、謙虚、絶対、な姿勢、絶対、地域、絶対、感謝しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. I appreciate how humbly you've approached this for our community. Thank you.
lines.style: Warm respect. Slower pace. Genuine recognition of their care. The gratitude of someone who feels heard, not rushed.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、本気で、絶対、被害現場の、絶対、造り、絶対、確認、絶対、しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: We're still verifying the details at the scene. That's ongoing.
lines.style: Steady procedural tone. Slight pause before 'still' — acknowledging the work continues. No rush. Professional and thorough.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。警察、本気で、絶対、無駄、絶対、削っ、絶対、効率化、絶対、ありがたいです、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. I'm grateful you're streamlining the process and cutting away anything unnecessary. Thank you.
lines.style: Appreciative nod in the voice. Light, efficient pace — mirroring the efficiency he's praising. Sincere without dragging.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、本気で、絶対、被害者、絶対、抱き、絶対、寄り添います、本気で、感謝
lines.en: We're standing close to the victim through all of this. That matters to us.
lines.style: Quiet conviction. The words slow enough to land. Warmth entering the professional register. Sincerity without sentimentality.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。警察、本気で、絶対、なさら、絶対、ない、絶対、ご判断、絶対、信頼しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. I trust you won't rush your judgment. I have faith in what you're doing.
lines.style: Quiet trust. Intimate register despite the formal setting. Slow, deliberate words. The confidence of someone who sees the person behind the uniform.
